title: Billavfaladi Churna
description: Billavfaladi Churna (Bilwadi Churna) is formulated with unripe Bael fruit (Bilva) and gut-binding herbs that restore healthy bowel function. This classical formulation is excellent for treating chronic mucus colitis where excessive mucus accompanies diarrhea. Addresses amoebiasis (parasitic dysentery) through anti-parasitic action. Treats bacillary dysentery (bacterial dysentery) through antibacterial action. Manages hyper-motile bowels (excessive bowel movement) through tissue toning.
dosage: Mixed with lukewarm water or fresh curd/buttermilk
